rab/ /mkhas shaṃng grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rdo grub chen 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i gsung 'bum legs bshad nor bu'i bang mdzod ba(1gas/si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

za da 3ba ——4—4྾ ba ———44 —ba ྾ba —ba 4— bab bab — —— sngon 'gro'i gtam/sana' rtsom ni mi rigs srol rgyun rig kanas kyi grub cha gal chen 'ib yin cing / krung hwa mi rigs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig sa/nas shul bzhag khrod kyi rin chen nor bu zhib yin/ de 'tshol sdud dang / das sgrig tho 'god/ par skrun bcas byed rgyu ni rang re'i tang dang rgyal khab kyis mi rigs phul byung rib sanas rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i bya ba rlabs chen zhig yin pas/ rang rgyal mi risas sa khongs rang skyong bca' khrims sogs bca' khrims dang srid jus su gsal bor gtan la phab yod ceng / rim pa khas bi mi dmangs srid sazhung nas 'di phyosas kyi bya ba 'bor chen bsgrubs shing / grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs/ nye ba'i lo shas ring / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas grangs nyung mi/ rigs gna' rtsom nang du 'dus pa'i rang rgyal mi rigs bana' rtsom 'tshol snyud dang /dag sgrig tho 'god sobs byed pa'i thad ched du yis/ cha pūd de satan phab sas ra ba mdzad cing / blang bya sasar ba bton/ spyi khyab hru'u ci nas kyang 6gna' rtsom das sgrig par skrun sgo sa mes rgyal gyi phul byung ris/ gnas shul bzhag rgyun 'dzin byas te/ krung bo'i

za na 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bsta na nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ———4—྾ ——ba zheb 4ba 4—྾—ba——྾྾——4——ba —4—khyad chos lda na pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos zhes pa'i bka' slob legs par basprul/bong bsal dkongs don lab/ star dngos 'bab byed ched/ngaXtshos rang skyong khul gyi don dngos dang zung 'brel byas te/ ched sanyer las khungs btsusas shing / ched mkhas mi sma skong 'jen dang ci nus sgos mthun rkyen bskrun pa1'i rmang bzhi'i steng de'i byed nus 'don sbul byas te/ bya ba 'di cung lnga ba'i sgo nas las 'bo brtsams/nga tsho'i thog ma'i rgyus lon ltar na/ mgo los sa cha'i sana' rtsom la mtshon na thon khungs cung 'bel bo yin par ma zad/brgyud nga1 ring zhing // rnam grangs mang la/ khyab rgya che ba dang / nang sases rigs kyis dbye na'ang brda sprod dang / rtsom rig lo rgyus/saso rib mtshan nyid rig pa/ rtsis bzhung / nang don rib pa sokas bod kyi srol rgyun ris sanas kyi khyab longs phal mo che zin cing 1 dpe rgyun dkon zhing rtsa chen du brtsi rung ba'i sana' bzhung yang mi nyung bar 'dusade phyir thog ma'i 'tshol sdud tsam gyi rmang ba'i'i steng //() 33lo nas bzung ste/ mgo log sa cha'i malas dbang rim byon gyi bsung rtsom gces bsgrib/sa dpe tshogs kyi tshul du〈khra dbe slong tshul 2

sngon 'gro'i btam/ za da 3ba ba ba ba ba ma ba — ba ྾ ba ra ba ba ba ——ba — — —— —tsukhrims dar rgyas kyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs〉sogs snga bzhug tu deb lnga drug tsam par skrun byas te/ rgya che'i klog pa po'i spya na sngar rim par bstar bas/ kun gyi gdeng 'jog lebs po byung zhing /bya ba de la 'bre' yod sde khag gis mthong gzigs gnang ste/ ched gnyer las khungs dang mi sna sogs la zhing chen rim pa'i bana' rtsom 'tshol sdud myur skyob kyi bya dga' dang bzengs bstod kyi dbubs dbyung thengs du mar gnang /nye 'a ma rgyal khab mi rigs don byed u yon lha na khang gis〈krung go'i grangs nyung mi ritsa/sa gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lab star byed pa'i shar rlung gi 'gros dang bsnyun zhing / rang skyong khul byi srid dbang btsugs nas lo 'khor lnga bcu 'khor bar sngon bsu zhu ba'i sta gon rtsom pa dang 'brel/ khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang gis sngar gyi rmang gzhi'i steng rim pa spaṭa nyu/nga gzhi rgya bskyed de/ slar yang〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs)〉'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig par skrun bcas byed pa'i jus gzhi gsar ba bzos/ pa ltar nga tshos bya ba 'di da lta dngos su lag star byed 'bo brtsams pa yin/de yang nga tshos bya ba 'di nyid sgrub pa'i mdzub ston bsam blo ni tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'brel yod mdzub )

ngo ba 3 rdo grub 'jisas med bsta na nyi'i bsung 'bum/ 4— 4ba ba zhe————————ba ——྾—4ba ——4———— ྾——4ston la brtsi srung sgos/ mi rigs phul byung rig gnas dar spel dang / mi rigs mthun sgril dang rig sanas brje res la shugs snon byed pa dmigs 'dun du byas te/ bden 'tshol lam/ tshan rig dang mthun pa'i spyod stangs la brten nas sa sanas mi rigs bana' rtsom sngog 'don myur skyob byas thos mi ribs kyi khyad chos lda na pa/'i spyi tshosas ring lugs dang/la yon 'dzusas skrun la zhabs 'desas zhu rgyu de yin/bya ba'i rtsa don ni chab srid 'du shes shugs dam zhing / srid jus dbye mtshams gsal bor byas te/ lo rgyus dang rtsod sgrubaXkyi lta ba spyad nas snyisas dor bcud len byed pa'i dus mtshungs su rig sanas kyi ngos nas snga ma'i rnam nga1 ji bzhin cha tshang du mchon ci nus/ byed cing / spyir btang du brtsams chos la dbya da brjod ci yang byed rgyu min/sazhan yang byed sgo'i shes byar slob sbyongaXdang / ched 'a sa shes byar tsacigs 'dzin byas te/ nan tan zhib tshags kyi bya ba'i spyod stangs la brten nas gnad sgo stangs 'dzin byas thos rgyun shes sam ched las rang bzhin gyi 'bal 'khrul sayol ci nus byed rgyu'ang spros ma dasgas/de dang mnyam du spu sa legs 'du shes/ chags par byas/ te/ ma

ngo nga 3 rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum—————ba ——ba — ——44—————ba —khya————————tshosas la thugs sazhigs yang yang mdzad pa las byung ba'i 'gro ba mi'i blo gros dang shes rab kyi mtshon byed shes rig gi legs skyes rmad du byung ba de dab yod pa dang / legs skyes de dab dus dang go mtshams kyi rgya las brgal te phyi rabs pa das la pha nor gyi tshul du shul 'job sanang bar brten/ nga tsho da lta dpal yon ldan pa'i spyi tshogs su 'tsho zhing / nga tshos bskru na pa'i shes rib la rmang gzhi dang khungs lung yod cing / brgyud pa dang lda na nga1ra gyur/ mabam pa nge tsho dang rib/ bzhung de tsho bzhusas pa sa rang bi risas rgyud 'di rnams da lta brgyud pa ring la zab cing rgya che ba'i thun min ris sanas shis si bdag por gyur yod la/ thes rig rnam par bkra ba dpal ldan 'dzam bu gling ba'i mi gral gyi star rir/ 'phang mi dma' bar 'tsho thub pa byung yod/de phyir mkhas pa'i dbang po rim par byon pa dag dang de dag bis mdzad pa'i legs bshad kyi glegs bam dab ni mi rigs shika dang sa gnas shig la mtshon na sazi brjid dang la rgya zhig yin 'dug la/ 'chang bar bya ba'i khyad nor dang 'phyar bar bya ba'i dge mtshan zhig yin par ma zad/ 'tsho bar byed pa'i bla srog dang khrab rgyun zhig tu smras kyang rung snyam/ 'di lha ra bsam/ na khong sngon byon gyi mkhas pa dag rang re la bka' drin bla lhag tu che bas 6

sngon 'gro'i btam/ pod 3babye——4rdob bdodayadi——ma ༷ma yabab rdo bab44ba༄0ma 4ba ———rtog— sa su rang nga snyang nas bka' na zhu 'os la/ sngon 'gro rtsom thung 'di yang khong rnam par dad gdung mos gus kyi yid rlabs g.yo bzhin bris pa lags/dus mtshungs su rang re gangs can nga1 das la bana' bo'i dus nas bzung mkhas pa la gong bkur dang shes rig la saces thang che ba'i srol rgyun bzang po zhis yod la/ yul mabo log 'dir mtshon na'ang dgon sde dang dbe 'dun pa das gis bshad sgrub kyi ngos nas so so'i mkhas pa dang de'i brtsams chos la satsigs su 'dzin pa tsam du ma zad/ yul khams byi nas kyang6 mkhas pa yon tan lngan pa dang / thi dkar yang tsha mthong ba stemimisog/sa kyis mchon te mkhas pa das phu dud bya ba'i yul gsum gyi satso bo'i bo sanas su bgrang ba'i srol 'dug cing / khong tsho ni legs bshad kyi 'byung gnas dang / lesas tshogs kyi rtsa ba/ yi rang dang mig ltos kyi mtshon dpe zhig tu brtsi ba dang / khong chos brtsams pa'i sasung chos dag ni bslab bya'i gnas shig dang / lugs gnyis blang dor pyi tshad gzhi zhig tu brtsi bar byed/ khyem rgyud dang rus rgyud dag la mtshon na rang gi khyim rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa dang de'i bsung chos de tsho so so rang rang gi khyim rgyud kyi khyad nor du byas tedu rabs tsha rgyud du bsrel bar byed pa'i dar srol yod pas/ dus 7

ngo da 3 rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—4———ba ——ba —ba ba ba ba ba ba —bar—ba ba ba —ba ——4———'gyur mang po'i khrod du'ang srog dang bsdos nas srung skyob byas 'dus da lta bsam na 'di ni boms srol lesas po tsam du ra1 zad snying stobs ribs this si mtshon byed du'ang rung bar snyar//de dag gi dbang gis sa gnas 'dir yang lo rgyus su ma khas pa mi nyung ba tsam byon cing / da lta'i bar 'tshol du yod pa'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos kyang mang tsam bzhubs la/ de chos thun min rin thang gi cha nas bshad na'ang lo rgyus su mabo lob 'di mdo khams 'brel mtshams su chags yod pas/ mdo kham/sa/ rib gnas ma lag che ba gnyis ka bcis 'dres su song ba'i nyams shig sna nga la/ bod brgyud nang bstan grub mtha'i dbang du btang na'ang lnga 'gyur rnying ma ba dang / ri bo dge lubs pa/ rgyal ba jo nang ba/ mnyam med bka' brgyud pa sogs grub mtha' che gras phal mo che zhig yun ring mnyam gnas su chags nga1sa/ dmangs1 khrod rig banas tshun gyi rib banas kun la sa cha bzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i sger khyad cig lha ger snang bar bsten/ rig gnas shul bzhas 'di rigs myur skyob thub pa byung na/ bod spyi'i srol rgyun rig kanas kyi dar rgyun nam brgyud pa gyes 'phel 'gro tshul dang /sa sanas thun min rig gnas grub stangs sosas zhib 'jus byed par don snying dang rin thang thin tu cheXbar gdon mi za la/ tha na 8

pod 3 rdo grub 'jegs med bsta na nyi'i bsung 'dum/———྾4—ba ba ba 4ba 4————ba ba ——————ba —ba — —4yod/de sngon gyi srid jus lesas po'i go skabs ma shor bar byas te/cha rkyen zhan cing dka' tshegs che ba la ma ltos par mthun rkyen bsar gtod sgos 'tshol sbud dang / dag sgrig myu ra skyob kyi las la rang rtogs ngang zhugs nas sa gnas rib gnas shul bzhaka rtsa chen dag chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i ched du 'bad nga1 yun ring bsten pa'i ched las don banyer mi sna dag bis don mthun gyi bya ba mang po bsgrubs song bas/ ngas 'dir khong tshor dka' las myang song 'es zhu zhing / kho bo rang ngos kyis bya ba de la rgyab skyor dang mthun rkyen sbyor ba'ang ldo ga med kyi 'os 'asan zhis tu brtsis yod/'on kyang rang khul gyi gna' rtsom ma lus par yongs su myur skyob byed rgyu ni da dung dus yun ring zhing dka' lab che ba'i bya ba 'is yin pas/ grub 'bras kyi rmang gzhi'i steng su 'thud nas rgyun 'khyongs lho da med kyi bya ba 'bor chen zhig bsgrub nga1 la ras las yod/mjug mthar mgo los gna' rtsom bya ba legs 'grub yong zhing / grub 'bras gzengs su thon pa'i smon 'dun zhu/ / zhes pad ma rnam rgyal nas2003 1༷ 1ba bris/()

pod 3 rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum1—ba 4ba ba ba ba ba ba ba —ba —ba ba bar—ba ba ba ba ——ba ba 4—0ba —gzhan phan 'jibs med phrin las 'od zer gyi sku phreng gsum par ngos bzung ste rdo grub chen pyi gdan sar 'khod na'ang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po ches brtag nga1 mdzad tshe gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i yang srid du grub pas/ khri chen gung thang pa'i sku skyer yang grags so/ /rdza stod du phebs nas 'jam dbyangs ngur smris 'chang ba'i rnam rol chen po rdza dpa' dbe sprul sgu o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i zhabs la btugs nas chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes pa/sa/lhas nga/'i lhas rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis brlabs te dgongs pa1 ye shes kyi klong rdol/ dgung lo brgyad du son nga1 chu pho sprel lor dpal sprul rin po ches da lo rdo grub sprul skus spyod 'juku yi bka' khrid gnang dgos zhes phyogs kyi slob bu mang du bsdus tshe/nye sanas 'khor dang bcas pas sprul sku khong snyu na chung drags pa sa re zhig 'khor de lta bu la bka' khrid mi 'ong zhes nan gyis zhus pa bka' bkyon gyis tshar bcad nga/ra brten/ bka' nan bzlog ma nus par rdza rgyal dgon du 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor la spyod 'jus chen mo 'i bka' khrid gnang ba na/ 'khor slob kun gyi lus kyi spu long dbang med g.yo 'ing / dad pa'i mchi ma sham sham 'bab pa'i tshod du chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor bas/ dpal spru' rin po 3

rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ por 3—rngorngo༅pang 4 bar—nga 11ba 4 bkarashārangar pa4b.rabyedabab ༷༷ba —dro ba ——ra' zhal nas/ rda grub r+yas pa la brgyad pas sa 'a'ar 'ad 'dra bskor nus pa'i tshul la dpag na/ da dung lung bi bstan pa'i gnas1 tshad rdzogs ran mi 'dug ces thugs dgyes pa chen pos basbags brjod kyi me tog yang yang 'thor/ snga phyir o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po dang / rdzogs sprul mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje/ rgya rong nam sprul kun bzang jes mchob rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang ngo / kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa nyag bla sater chen1 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho sogs dam pa mang du bsten nas/ 'dul ba dbu tshad phar phyin sobs gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i zab chos spyi dang / mdo sgyu sems gsum/ bka' dbongs phur gsum/ snying this gong 'os sogs lnga 'gyur bka' babs kyi chu bo rnam bzhi dang 'brel ba'i bka' gter smin grol pyi dbang lung khrid gsum/ mdo smad rdi tsha dbon gyi mgo log sprul sku 'gya ba a lags sogs las kun ma//khyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yig chas gtso byas ri bo dge lda na pa ltar gyi bzhung bka' pod lnga sosas mdor na mdo lngags bsar rnying grub mtha' ris med kyi lta grub kun la khengs pa dang skyo ngal med ba ra thusas 'dris sasan bsam mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grasas pa ches cher rgyas// 3

rnga da 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba ba —ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ——ra ba ba 4ba ba ma ba ba — ba —ba——4rab tshes lcags 'brug spyi lo1880lor mgo 'o sa pad ma 'bum dpon shob brgyad kyis ched du phul ba'i bzhugs gnas rdo yul khri zhes bya bar dbon gnas katsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling zhes bya ba gsar du bzhengs pa/ phyis ming zur shubs kyis 'gyur te gsang chen bangos grub dpal 'bar gling du grags/de tsam nas dgon pa de'i g.yon ngos brdzi med bkra leb gong mar thang sto nga rgyal po'i lha khang du grags pa'i dben khrod cis tu sprub pa rtse sacig mdzad pas/ tshul khrims kyi dri bsung zhim pos lor yug dus kun 'gengs la/ lhas pa'i lha la mi dang mi lab pa bzhin bgro gleng byed cing / ma gza' dam gsum mir brdzus nas glebs bam skyel 'bul byed pa/ nyin lam du ma'i sar rab banas kyi 'bru char 'beb pa sogs mngon shes dang brdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med pa'i grub pa'i bo 'phang mthon por gathegs kyang / rtag tu sbas pa'i brtul zhusas kho nar dgyes pas don gyi gsang ba sus kyang dpobs par dka'/ ba/zhan yang gangs ri'i ljongs su bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog dang / bka' gter rnying rgyud/ bod kyi mkhas grub ris med kyi gsung 'bum gleg/sa bam gas ra ba'engs sogs bya ba las kyi phrin las kyang rgya cher spel/ma1thar rab byung bco lnga ba'i zad pa me stab gi lor( 1() 2( ) )1

ngo da 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'gum/————ba ——ba ba ba ba ba —ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba —ba ba ——ba ——ba —bshad 'di nyid kho na las gzhung logs su brtsams pa thig bod na med nga1ra grags pas// 〈sazungs rnam〉'di'i dpe zhig a mdo dbe bshes 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi phyas brgyud nas kun sa/zigs bcu gsum pa chen po'i spyan sngar phul bas dgyes bzigs dang bsngags brjob yang yang gnang bar bsung la/ rdo grub khong rang nas kyang((gsang snying〉dang〈gzungs rnam〉)gnyis ka snying dmar rjen du bstan nga1 yin ces lan du mar bsung bar grasas/ (rdogazungs rnam〉dang4(gter rnam〉〉gnyis dbyin ji sogs kyi yi ger bsgyur yod pa'ang nye lam thos so/ /bzhan yang khong gi kasung chos gang la'ang rtsom nyams dang rtsom stangs kyi cha nas thun mong 'a rjes bzlos su ma song ba'i khyad chos shis yod la/ snya na rtsom la'ang 'gyur bag dang ro nyams gzhan dang bzhan la yong dka' ba'i cha bklasas pa tsam gyis lhas ger myong thub nga1 zhis yod pas/gsung mgur dang / satam tshogs khrod kyi sprung thung dab la rtsom ris sga nyams 'gyur dang rin thang ngo mtshar ba jig yod par sngon dang da lta'i ngag rig smra ba kun zhal gcig tu gleng ngo / /'es pa'ang lnga ris smra ba bde legs rab rgyas su 'bod pas khul gna' rtsom gzhung las khang gis bskul ngor zla tshes dge bar 'phral mar sbyar ba'o// //6

dkar chagasngon 'gro'i gtam/ ༷ ( / )rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ ༷ ( )bsang snying spyi don rnam 'byed rin chen mdzod lde/ ༷༷ (/ )sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi spyi don ngag 'gros su bkod pa/ ༷ ༷( 307)sgyu 'phrul bskyed rdzobs skor/ ( snye2/)'jar/ dpal bsto da 'grel/༷ ༷ ( rte691rgyal sras bslab bya nyams len snying po'i bsdus 'grel/ ( 1 3 6)mabon po'i snyan brgyud lung snying don bshad/ ༷ (605)bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ ༷ ( )
ma / /dpal gsang ba'i snying po'i rgyud kyi spyi don nyung ngu'i ngag gis rnam par 'byed pa rin chen mjod kyi lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs so//

pod/ ༈ rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba ba 4—ba —ba —nga 0ba ba ba ba ba ma ba ba ba ba ba ra ba ba 0— 0ba ba ba rab/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' la phyas 'tshal lo/ /don dam/ dbyings dang sgrib bral rig pa'i sku/ /mi phyed rdo rje grub pa'i gzi brjid sprin1 sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i skur mdzad rgyudaji'i dbyangasaṃ/ /kun khyab 'khor lo'i dbang phyug bla mar 'dud1 /bsang mchog rgyud sde'i snang bas gdul bya'i gling / /grub gnyis lang tsho rgyas pa'i pad tshal du/ /sprub mdzad brgyud gsum/ bla ma/'i nyin mor byed/ /yid mkha'i ngos la brtan nga1ra bzhugs gyur cibargyud don zab mo bdag 'dras dpag dka' yang / /skyes gu'i brjod pa'i rjes 'brangs brag cha ltar/ /brgyud lda na bla ma'i lebs bshad la brten nas/ /cha tsam gleng 'dir kuzu bo'i blo yis1 nyon//'dir sba 'gyur bka' gter gyi bstan nga1 rgya mtsho'i nang mdzod/ /gsang lngags chu bo baji yi 'byung ponas// rgyud lung man ngab thams cad kyi srob shing / rgyal ba'i dbongs pa mthar thus bi sning po bcud du dril ba/ sems dang ye shes rang sna nga bden nga1 dbyer med du ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba gsang ba'i snying ngo/ de kho na nyid nges pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i spyi don gyi rnam bzhag cung zad brjed byang du 'god pa la bsum ste/ sto na nga sa ji ltar gsungs tshul/ de 'a sa ji ltar brgyud tshul/ brgyud pa nge lda na gyi rgyud don dngos bshad pa'o/ /sna—

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pob/ 3—ba ba 4ma ma ba ba ra ba —ba ba ba ba —ba ba ba ba —4ba ba ba —dang po ni/ 'o skol rnams kyi ston pa bdag nyid sngid pa'i 'ching ba mtha' dag las gro' yang / sem/sa can 'khor ba'i gzeb du chud cing rmongs pa'i mun nag stu ga pos non pa// nges par 'byung ba'i phyogs yongs su mi shes pa rnams la thugs rje chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur te/ nyi ma bye ba phrag brgya'i 'od kyis mi mtshon pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi snang ba rlabs/ po che 'gyed pa'i slad du skye rgu tshe lo brgya ba la babs pa'i dus su rigs thams cad las rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mtho ba shākya'i ris/sa kyi rgyal po zas satsang ma'i sras su skye ba'i pad+mo dbang 'byor gyi yon tan mtha' yas pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa bzung ste/ shākya thub pa'am shākya seng ge zhes snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po sa gsum na mngon par gsal ba des/dang por sazhon nu'i rol rtsed dang / rig pa slob pa dang /btsun mo'i 'khor du bzhugs pa la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi spyod pa'i tshul dang mthun pa'i thabs mkhas pa mang pos sems can yo ngas/ su smin par mdzad nas// lo nyi shu rtsa dgu bzhes pa na rgyal po'i srid 'byor spangs te rab tu byung / klung ne rañdza na'i 'gram du dka' thub mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i tshe phyosas bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis bsnyul nas btags pa'i lus der bzhag ste ye shes kyi lus 'og min du gshegs nas mngon byang lngas byang chub brnyes //rte

por/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bsta na nyi'i gsung 'burme/4—bab4—ba ba ba bab ra ba ba bar—ba ba ྾ba ba —ba ba —babange nas ri rab kyi rtse dang / rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang // o rgyan dang /za hor rnams su gshegs nas 'khor dag pa rnams la 'di nyid la sogs pa'i gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde mtha' yasaXpa bstan/ slar btags ji1'i lus la zhusas nas byang chub snying por bshesas pa1 sosas mdzad pa lhag ma rnams mthun snang du bstan/ de star sprul pa'i skus gsangaXsngags bstan pa dang / 'og min du longs skus sasang sngasas bstan pa banyis byad dang sazusas brnyan lta bu yin pas phyi ma'i gnas skabs spangs nas snga mar mdzad pa ni ma yin te/slob dpon nyi 'od seng ges rgya cher 'grel du bshad tshul lo/ /ston pas mi yu' du byang chub brnyes pa'i mdzad nga1 bstan nas thes nga1 thun mong gi chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus su longs spus 'os min du rgyud sasungs pa'i phyogs ni sges pa rdo rjes spar lab tu bshad pa'i tshul lo/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po yang phyi ma dang mthun par bzhed de/ bang du rgyud gsungs pa'i 'os min de la dbang phyus chen po'i 'og min te longs snyu'i zhing gi 'og min dang /de'i rjes mthun sprul sku'i 'og min sanyis yod cing / phyi ma la'ang byed sprul longs skur grags pa rang bzhin sprul sku'i jing khams dang / gtsang ris lha gnas kyi 'og min gnyis gsungs so/ / bshad tshul de dab gang yang mi 'gal te/ de bzhin sashegs nga1'i 1

gsang snying byi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pong/ 34ba—྾ba ba ba —ba 4྾—4 ——ba ba 4ba —྾zheb —ba rnam 'phrul gyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes mkhas pa dag sasungs so/ /spar khab tu bshad tshul 'di la brten nas snga ma/༷kha cig /mi yul du sprul sbus thun mong gi jeg pa tsam las ma hā yo sa'i rgyud ma gsungs par 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ rtsa rgyud nyid las sprul skru 'i mdzad pa 'dul ba baji'i nang tshan sasung gis 'dul ba'i skabs su/ bla na med pa'i dzeg pa dang zhes sasungs pa sobs dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro1 /'og min du gsung tshul ni le'u dang pos dngos bstan gtso bo yin pas longs sprul gyis gsung tshul gnyis ka rgyud nyid na sasa' ba yin no/ /sanyis pa la/ brgyud bsum spyi'i rnam bzhag dang / so so'i ngos 'dzin phyes te bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bshad rgyud rgya mtsho las/ rgyal ba sems dpa' rnal 'byor pa/ /dbongs pa rig pa rna bar brgyud/ /ces pa ltar ༅sum ste/ sasang ྅ gas snga 'gyur ba'i brda chad thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /de la rgyal ba dkongs brgyud ni gnyis te/ dper na nam mkha'i zla ba gcis/ pu la ri bong gi gzubs yod pa nyid kyis chu zla ji snyed shar ba thams cad ri bong gi rgyan dang ldan par snang ba zhin du/ 'chad pa'i skyes bu rigs drug pas rgyud don mthar phyin par brnyes pa nyid kyis de las sprul pa'i gshegs pa gshegs ma dang / sems dpa' 6

por 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—ba—bab ——ba ba ba ———ba ba ba ba ྾ba ba 4r+sha྾———— yab yum zhi khro'i 'khor thams cad rgyud don brnyes par 'jog nus te/ de ni gadzu 'khor dgongs pa sacig gis brgyud pa yin no//ston pa dang rgyud tha dad ba 'i lhan cig pa'i 'khor rnams la zab dbang bskur ba'i dbongs pa mdzad pas sto na 'khor dbongs pa dbyer med du gyur pa'ang dgongs brgyud kyi tshul gcig ko/ /sems dpa' rig brgyud ces pa ni/ gzhan du rig 'dzin brda brgyud ces 'byung ba dang mthun te/ 'chad pa po dag nga1'i sems dpa' sngags kyi ye shes las grub pa'i sku brnyes pas rgyud yongs su smin pa'i byang sems kyi 'khor la thugs rig pa'i ye shes kyi dkongs nga1 satad nas sbags dang phyag rgya'i brda thabs1 bstan pa tsam gyis de'i mod la 'bor gyis rgyud don mtha' das rtogs pa ste/'di yang dbongs pa don brgyud khyad par can yin yang / rgyal ba dgongs brgyud kyi brgyud tshul las gzhan du go ba'i ched du ༷ dkongs brgyud ces ma smos par ris pas brgyud pa 'es pa'i brda sbyar pa yin no/ /rnal 'byor rna brgyud ces pa'i rnal 'byor ni1dang po nas rig sngags kyi lhar bzhengs pa lta bu ma yin par tha mal pa'i rten bzung nas lam bsgoms te drod ci rigs thob pa yan chad de/ 'di ni thun mong bdul bya'i snang tshod dbang btsan par bya'i/ gnas tshod lhar na 'di'i rnal 'byor pa la rgyal ba 6

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3— ba ——ba ba ba ma ba ma —ba ba ba ba —ba — ྾——4bar྾— 4 4—bdang sems dpa'ang yod de/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma bzhin no/ /de lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa snga ma lnga ma'i zhal nas phyi ma phyi ma'i snyan du dbang rgyud man ngag rim bzhin brgyud pa ni rna brgyud do/ /sangs rgyas nang phan tshun la'ang slob pa'i rna brgyud 'dra ba med kyang snyan du brgyud tshul tsam yod pa mi 'gal bar kun mkhyen chen pos gsungs shing mdo rgyud du ma'i lung gis kyang grub pas / rgyal ba la dargongs brgyud kho na dang sems dpa' la rib brgyud kho na zhes bshad mi rung ngo 1 /des na rnal 'byor pa 'a rna brgyud badzu/sems dpa' nas brgyud tshul thun min ris pa'i brgyud pa dang /sangs rgyas dngos kyis brgyud tshul thun min dbongs brgyud yin zhes bshad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/ sems dpa' ris brgyud/ rnal 'byor rna brgyud do/ /dang po ni/ ston pa rigs drus pas rgyal tshab rigs lnga sobs dang / ribs lngas lha na cis pa'i 'khor la brgyud pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ mi ma yin la brgyub pa dang / mi dang mi min gnyis ka la brgyud pa sanyis/dang po ni/ rgyal sras rigs sasum sems dpas lha klu gnod sbyin gyi ris 'dzin grags ldan mchos skyong sogs gsum la bshad do/ /banyis pa ni/ rgyal ba ji bar sazims nas lo nyer brgyad 'das 7

za ra/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bsta na nyi'i bsung 'bum/———ba ————ba ba — ba——ba 4ba —ba —ba 4ba —ba ba——4—nga1 na dam pa'i rigs can drwa ma lnga laṅka'i yul gyi grong brdal gyi mcho gling ri ma la ya'i rtse mor rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dus te/ sangs rgyas la dmibs nas gdung dbyangs blangs pas dpal phyag na rdo rje mngon sum du byon nas rgyud bshad do/ /bsum pa la/ mi yul du rgyud 'di thog mar byung tshul dang / de las ji lhar brgyud tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ bshad ma thag pa lta ra/ gsang bdas blus bama' bsdu mdzad pa'i tshe de'i byin rlabs kyis sa ho ra'i rgyal po dza ste i n+t+ra sgo ti la/ sbu bsung thugs rtabs thim pa dang 1 rin chen glegs bam babs pa dang / chos kyi bgro ba byed pa dang /kun gyis dam par bsgrags pa dang / mchod pa chen po byas/ pa ngang / rin chen char du babs pa dang / sangs rgyas sa la lung bstan pa'o/ /zhes pa'i rmi ltas bdun byung zhing / de dang mthun pa1ra pho brang gi steng du rgyud sde'i glebs bam dang phyag na rdo rje'i sku khru sang ba dngos su babs te gsol ba btab pas sngon bsang sgabs la byi ngas pa'i 'phro sad de rdor sems 'al mthong bi/ le 'u rtosas nas de dang phyag rdor gyi sgu la brten te zla ba drub bsgru bas pa sa rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mjal zhing byin gyis brlabs nga1sa glesas bam gyi don mtha' das mkhyen par gyur to/ /sanyis nga1 ni/rgyal po des ku ku rā dza la bshad/ de nas rim bathin in+t+ra bhu nyi1 8

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde / ro da/ 3——— bab——4ba —ba rtse ba ———ba sheb —ba bzhe4 4—— 4——— — —seng ha rā dza/ u pa rā dza1 sras mo go ma dī wi'i bar du brgyud de/de rnams ni tshom bu dang bcas te rig 'dzin gyi sa la gshebs pa sha stas bo/ /bo ma dre wis sgeg rdor dang sangs rgyas sasang ba la bshad/ sangs rgyas gsang bas slob dpon chen po pad+ma dang bi ma mi tra la bdams te 'phags yul du byung ba'i tshul lo/ /bod du ni/slob dpon pad+mas rje 'bangs 'dus pa la lta phreng gsungs pa sosas de las brgyud pa'ang yod par snang mod/ gong ma rnams la grasas che ba ni/ be ma las rma gnyags gnyis la gdams/ de gnyis nas brgyud pa'i chu bo gsum du gyes/ pa gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la gcig tu 'dres/ des banubs yon tan rgya mtsho dang so ye shes dbang phyug la bshad/ de sanyis ka la nyang shes rab mchog gis zhus/ de nas nyang ye shes 'byung sanas/ zur bo che shākya 'byung gnas/ zur chung shes rab grags/ thugs sras ka ba bzhi// sgro phus pa shākya seng se'i bar du brgyud/ gnyags gnubs zur gsum de dag la ga/sang sngags kyi babs so gsum du grabs/sgro phub pa la thugs zin gyi slob ma bcu sanyis gdusas thogs kyi slob ma grwa sa 'dzin pa stong sogs byung ste rgyud 'di'i phrin las phyosas med du brdal/ de'i slob brgyud satsang nas 'od 'bar/mes ston mgon po/ /sro shes rab tshul khrims/ rta nag bdud ()

za ra/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'a3m/4bab 4— —ba 4ba —ba ba ba ra ba ba ma ba ba ba ba ba ra ba ——3—ba bab0'dul 'bum/ mda' shākya 'phel/ zur byam/sa pa seng ge/ rje sgrol sayung rnam gnyis/ sgrol chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'bos lo chen po gzhon nu dpal/ karma zhwa dmar bzhi ba chos kyi grags pa/ 'bri gung rin chen phun tshogs/ rang grol nyi zla sa ngas rgyas/'khon jo sras tshe dbang nor rgyas/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur chen bkra shis kun dga'1 dar sdings riku 'dzin phrinaXlas lha na grub/ gter chen chos kyi rgyal po 'gyur med rdo rje/de la lo chen dharma shrīs gsan/ sater chen sku mched 'di sanyis thusas sras dang bcas pas rgyud 'di'i dbang dang / sgrub thabs/dkyil chog /rgyud 'grel/ mtha' dpyod sobs1 rin ngo/ che'i sgron me lha bu'i legs bshad mang du mdzad cing / 'chad nyan gyi rgyun btsugs pas bstan pa la bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab/ nge nas rim/ nga1ra brgyud de mkhas grub dam pa dge rtse bsod nams bstan 'jin nam 'jigs med ngo mtshar nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pad+ma bkra shisardo/ de la rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyis bsan/ nges bdab cag gi bla ma 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi thugs sras kun mkhyen spru la pa'i sbu o rgyan 'jibs med chos kyi dbang bo dang /dkyil 'alor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag ma/khan chen rdo rje 'chang pad+ma dam chos 'od zer dpal bzang po gnyis la basprul cing 1 lnga (3

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3— bab —ba ba ——ba — ——ba —ba —ba ba —4྾44ba 4— ba bams rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams rnam rgyal dang / phyi mas rnam 'dren rje btsun dam pa mi pham rnam rgyal rin po cher gdams pa nas kyang brgyud de/ mdor na kho bo 'ba' zhig ma gtobs pa rgyud sde'i gnas la spyangs pas mkhas pa'i so 'phang brnyes shing /'khor lo'i lha la bsnyen pa las su rung ba/ rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa'i drod thob pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi phreng ba bar ma chad par brgyud pa las da lta'i bar du dbang gi chu bo ma skam/ bshad pa'i sgro na me ma nub/ byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od ma yal bar byon pa yin no/ /lo rgyus 'di dag gi zhib cha ni gzhan las thes par bya'o//ba/sum pa la/ bshad bya 'chad byed 'chad tshul gsum gyi rnam bzhag mdo tsam brjod pa dang / rgyud don dngos bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ spyir gsang sngags bla med la/ ma hā/ a nu/ a ti yo sa'i rgyud sde sasum ste1 de gsum gyi khyad pa1ra la/ rgyud thams cad kyi snying bo'i don mthar thug pa ni 'od gsal gnyus ma'i de kho na nyid zab gsal banyis su med pa'i mtshan nyid can nyag gcig yin zhing / don de la dang por 'jus pa'i sgo mi 'dra ba sasum ste/ sgu gsum lam byed kyi bskyed chos rgyas pa dang /bskyed chob gi spros pa nye bar bsdus kyang dbyings dang ye shes lam byed kyi phyogs banyis la rim gyis slob pa dang / bcos ma/'i 1

por/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i bsung 'a3m/————4— —4———————— cho——————she྾—————bskyed chog la mi ltos par rtsol med rang bzhas bi thabs1 kyis ye shes mngon du byed pa'o/ 1de las dang po satso bor ston pa1 dang /banyis pa dang gsum pa satsor ston pa rim bzhin ma hā sosas bsum/ du bzhag par khas blangs na re zhib 'chad bde zhing ros bi bzhed pa dang yang mthun no/ /ji skad brjod pa'i bskyed chog rgyas basbus dang / dkyi' 'khor rgyas bsnyus mi sacib la mtha' bcod pa sazhan yang mang ste mang bas 'jibs so/ /ma hā la yang bde 'dus sgrub pa lung gi bka' sgo las/ ma hā'i ma hā ni lha 'i dkyil 'khor rim pas bskyed pa'o/ /ma hā'i a nu ni rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor lha na gyis grub pa'o/ /ma hā'i a ti ni don dam ngo bo ma skyes pa'o/ /zhes gsungs nga1 ltar rim 'jus bi spros nga1 che chung 'a ltos te sasum du phye ba lasaX'adir ni kun byed las/ ma hā rdo rje 'chang 'dod pas/ /thabs dang shes rab sgo ra zhugs nas/ /rang rgyud dag pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhis sgrub par byed/ /ces pa ltar ston pas ma hā yo ga'i rgyud dang / de'i nang nas kyang chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par rtsal du bton nas ston pas ma hā'i a tir 'jog nga1 sgyu 'phrul mkhan po phal che ba'i bzhed pa ste dpe chung rang gnas kyi 'gre' nga1 be ma las mdzad pa dang / bde 'dus gsang lngabs bka'i sde mis la 2

ngo da/ 3 rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'a3m/—4ba—ba —ba —— ————ba———————4——ba————————8/sa rgyud don mngon shes kyis 'chad nus pa dang / 'bring yi dam lhas mngon sum du byen gyis brlabs pas rgyud 'grel nus pa dang / tha ma rig 'dzin bong ma'i man ngag gi brgyud nga tshad lda na mnga' ba ci rigs kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud 'grel dang man ngas thor bu rnams te spar khab dang 'grel chung piṇ+ḍaze sogs dang / lam rim/ thugs thig /lta phreng la sogs pa'o/ /rigs pa ni rtog se thes pa'i nga rgyal dang / gzu lum gyis rgyud kyi rdo rje'i sanas la bshad nga1 byed pa ni rang bzos bstan nga1 dkrubs pa yin zhing /'di las 'di bshad ces pa'i tshis spyi'i bo yul ṅka ma po mang du yod kyang rgyud don las sazhan du bkri bar mi nusaXng1'i nges pa brtan po mi rnyed pas rtsa rgyud kyi don bshad rgyud rnams la brten nas grub thob so so'i man ngag/ blus ji ltar bkral ba bathin du 'thad pa'am rgyu mtshan rnam nga1ra dag pas rang nyid nges shing gzhan la 'chad mkhas pa bces so/ /rgyud 'chad pa 'i tshul la lha rje zur bo che/ rgyud rgyud kyis// rgyud 'grel bas/ rgyud sprub thabs kyis/ rgyud man ngag gis bshad pa ste bshad tshul bzhir bzhed pa dang / khob gzhung gsal sgron las/ spyi don gyis khob dbub1dkyus kyis sa bcad/ tshib sis 'bru gnon/ brgal lan gyis satan la dbab pa ste bzhir bshad pa sobs rgyud gzhung spyi'i —

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ ngo nga/ 4—— —— 4 ba ———ba ———4 bab ba——— ———ba ———— ba —'chad thabs dang 1 lta ba brgal brtag gis dang / spyod pa 'jug thabs kyis dang / dkyil 'khor don rtags kyis dang /dbang bdams ngag sis dang / dam/ tshig rnam grangs kyis dang /phrin las chos bsgrigs kyis dang / sgrub pa phyas ba'es kyis dang /ting nge 'dzin bskyed rdzobs kyis dang / mchod pa phyi nang bis ༷ dang / sngags sgra dab sdebs kyis dang / phyag rgya bskyed rim gyis bshad pa ste rgyud kyi dngos po so so'i bshad thabs gnyis so/ /banyis pa ni/ gsang bdas sgro phug nga1sa bzhed pa'i/ rang bzhin dngos po'i sanas tshul/ ma rtobs 'khrul pa'i sna nga tshul/thams cad mkhyen pas sazitsas tshul/ brtse ba'i thugs rje skyes tshul/'gro don ji lta ra mdzad tshul dang lngas 'chad pa sobs yod mo/da kyi/bla ma dam pa rnams sgyu 'phrul khos gzhung las/ rab la mtshan ༷ bstan 'bring la dbye/ /tha mar 'bru ba/nyer dgrol ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brang ste 'chad par mdzad pas 'dir yang de bzhin du bshad par bya'o/ /de la sasum/ mgo smos pas yo ba'i gdul bya dbang po rab la rgyud kyi mtshan bstan pa/ cung zad phye ste bshad pas bo/ ba'i dbang 'bring la spyi don rnam par dbye ba dang / rnam par spros pas go ba'i dbang po tha ma la 'bru re kunyer re'i sgo nas bshad pa'o/ /—

za ra/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i bsung 'bum/—ba———————ba—ba—ba ——ba — ba ba ba ———————0de yang gdul bya shes rab kyi 'jug pa myur ba'i dbang rdon rnams la mtshan don bshad pa tsam pyis rgyud kyi brjod bya'i gnad mtha' das rtogs nus pas de'i ched du mtshan bsta na pa yin yang de kho na'i ched du mtshan bstan pa min te/ dbang po 'bring tha sanyis la mabo smos pas go ba'i bas chasas bzhag pa'i ched du'ang bstan dbos pa'i phyir ro/ /dbang 'bring la spyi don bshad pas rgyud don gyi 'gangs gshog pa'i go ba skyed nus nga1sa btso bor nge la bstan par bya ba yin yang / dbang po tha ma la'ang 'bru sanyer dgrol ba'i sngon du lus rnam bzhas la bslab pas dkyu sa mthong nas rta rgyug pa ltar gzhung gi tshig don bzung bde ba'i dbos pa yod do/ /mtshan la rnam grangs gaspum gyi dang po rgyud dang dkyil 'khor gyi satso bo dang 'chad pa'i skyes bu sasum gyi mtshan thun mong du bsta na pa ni rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ste/ de'i don yang bshad rgyud me long las/ chos rnams ma lus sanyis med pa'i/ /rang rib byang chub sems nyid do/ /tha dad med pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /rdo rje zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /zhes pas/ rdo rje ni mi phyed mi thigs pa ste shes rab stong pa nyid do/ /'di'i gong 'og tu stong nga1 nyid ces bshad pa rnams ni 'od gsal gyi rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog pa'i cha la spros pa'i kun rtob dang bden dngos sanyis char 1 )

gsang snyi nga spyi don rin chen mdzod we/ pod/ 3——ra —ba —ba ba ba 4 — ba4bab ba 4ba4ba —— —— ——4 4bgyis stong pas stong pa kho na'i rnam pa can yin pa dang // man ngab dang lda na pa'i nol 'byor pas de la mnyam par bzhag pa nyid kyis stong nyid la mnyam par bzhas par 'gro bas der brjod de/ 'di la kun mkhyen bla ma dang gter bdag gling pa sogs ma yin dgab/ bi stong nyid ces gsungs te/ de ni thabs shes gnyis kyi nang nas shes rab kyi phyobs yin pas shes rab ces bya yi/ sems byung shes rab min no/ /sems dpa' ni sa twa'i sgra skabs 'dir brtan bsnyus rtogs gsum la bshad de/ thabs rang rig pa byang chub kyi sems thes rab stong pa nyid dang ro sacig pa'i zung 'jus rang bzhin rnam dag de thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i dus su sanas thing mtshan nyid ga'an du mi 'gyur bas brtan pa dang / de nyid kyi phyag rgyas brtan sayo kun la btab pa'am/ brtan sayo thams cad de'i cho 'phrul du shar bas mnyam pa nyid du sanas pas na basbus pa dang / gnas lugs rdo rje lta bu'i don de nyid sgrib pa dang bral zhing tshogs chen gnyis rdzobs pa'i mthus ji bzhin par mngon du mdzad pa ni rtogs pa ste/ snga ma gnyis sa'i/ 'bras banyis su med pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' zhes gnas tshul la lto sa nas bzhag cing / phyi ma 'bras bu'i rdor sems zhes snang lugs dri bral kyi cha nas bzhag bo/ /de nyid mtshan ma'i phyas rgyar snang ba 1 (

pob/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ 4—ba——ba ba bab— —ba —ba ——4ra — 44—— bar44————4dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang 'chad pa'i skyes bu mi bskyod pa 'a 'ang rdo rje sems dpa' zhes grasas te/ brtan basbus rtobs bsum gcig tu gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sadzu bo dngos mi slob zung 'jus yin yang rdo rje brtam basbus gnyis bsgrub bzhir bzung ste rtogs pa'i rdo rjeXlam byed la sanas pa'i bskyed rim gyi rdor sems dang / de yar lda na du song ba'i rdzosas rim pa'i rdor sems kyang cha 'dra tsam/ du bya dgos so/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ni/ rdo rje las/thabs dang thes rab 'brel ba'iXdon/ /sgyu 'phrul zhes ni ba'ir ba༅da do/ /zhes pas/ rtob tshogs11/ nges don/ drang don/ lha rtog dbyer med kyi sgyu drwa bzhi las/ dang po ni/ 'byung ba shes rab rigs kyi yum/ /'es pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar 'byung ba lnga'i bcud 'dus pa'i thib le'i cha phra ba rnams phung khams kyi sna nga ba ris su ma chad par 'char ba'i gzhir gyur pas na sgyu ma dang /de las phung khams rags pa'i cha sna tshogs su shar ba ni 'phrul ba dang / de gnyis rten dang brten par 'brel ba la drwa ba zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar snang ba sgyu ma ltar ris med du 'char ba'i gnad mthar thug ni shes rab sto nga pa nyid yin pas de la sgyu ma zhes bya zhing / de'i rang ma/dngas thabs rig pa rang byung bi ye shes su sasal ba la 'phrul ba dang / de sanyis ngo bo dbyer med du 18

za da/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'apyim/—————ba ba——ma — 4—྾ba—ba——4—ba —4——ba ——ba—dang rgyud thams cad kyi lung gi spyi zhes pa ste/ de'i don yang rdo rje las/ so sor bstan pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud/ /'dir ston 'dis sto na 'di phyir ston/ /don kun 'di la yongs rdzogs pas/ /lung gi spyi zhes bshad pa yin/ zhes gsungs te/ ra/tshan nyid rbes nga1'i sa/sung rab kyi brjod byar gyur pa mngon mtho dang / nges lesas dang / thams cad mkhyen pa sprub pa'i lam thams cad 'di'i lam stegs su bstan cing / gsang lngags phyi ba'i mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi lam dang / khyad par rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud sde mtha' das gi brjod bya'i snying po zab bsal gnyis med kyi sand gsang ma lus pa rgyud 'dir ston pa dang / sde snad dang rgyud sde gzhan thams cad 'dir bstan pa'i don de dab nyid las brtsams te ba/sungs pas 'di las 'phros pa dang / bstan pa de das thams cad rgyud 'di'i dkongs don lhab pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med la 'jus pa'i ched du dngos sam brgyud nas gzhol ba ste/ de dag gi phyir lung thams cad kyi spyi chings su gyu ra pa yin no/ /'di la 'u nga dang mthun pa'i mtshan zhes kyang gsung ngo / /gsum pa don rang bi ngo bo las btabs pa'am ma1na ngas dang mthun pa'i mtshan ni/ gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa 'es glegs bam gyi klad du 'byung ba nyid de/ 'di la bi ma la'i 2(/

bsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ por/ 3— ba ba ba ba ba ba ra༅ 2nga ba bathab〉 pa—ngarabab ba bab babab ba ba ba ba ba —'grel chung du/ /rang bzhin gsang ba zhes bya ste/ /che ba zhes bya snying po'i don/ /de kho na nyid mtshan nyid de/ /nges pas nges don mdor bstan pa/ /zhes mtshan gyi zur bzhi pos rgyud kyi rang bzhin dang / che ba dang / mtshan nyid dang / nges pa'i don rnams bstan par bshad do/ /'dir spyi'i don phyogs tsam brjod na/ mdo phal po che las stong gsum gyi 'jig rten 'di rgyu rkyen ches mang po dang ches sna tshogs las 'grub pa dper mdzad nas rgyu tshogs nyung ngu dang mdor bsdus pa tsam gyis rdzobs pa'i byang chub mi 'grub par gsungs pa ltar gdul bya rgya chen po la mos pa rnams la bstan pa'i theg chen pha rol tu phyin pa ltar na tshogs sanyis kyi spyod pa'i bye brag dang / dus dang / slob tshul gyi thabs mkhas mtha' yas pa zhig la ngal ba ma bsten par byang chub 'thob pa gnas med kyang / zab mo la mos pa'i gdul bya skal pa rab mchob ldan pa rnams la bstan pa'i gsang ba bla med kyi skabs 'dir ni dpal kha sbyor thig ler/ de phyir de rgyas ci zhis bya/ /mdor bsdus pas ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces sogs gsungs pa ltar/ lam mdor bsdus kyis 'grub pa dang / de'ang snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la 'grub pa dang / bde blab nyid du 'grub pa dang / lam gzhan bsna na pa la mi ltos par 'di nyid kho nas 2 /

za da/ 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum /—ba ba ba — —ba —ba ba ba ba ྾ma —4ba ——ra ba ba ྾———————'grub pa'i khyad par dang ldan la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang / phyi rgyud sde gsum man chad du gsal bar ma brnya na pa'i ye thes lam byed kyi gnad thun min cig yod pa de gtan la phab pa nyag sacis si mthu yin zhing / de 'dra de la rgyud 'di 'a sa lhag pa bangen banyis dbyer med kyi chos sgu chen po'i rnal 'byor zhes gsungs te/ 'di'i brjod bya'i mthil ni de yin no/ /de'i phyir mtshan gyi zur 'di dag thams cad kyis kyangaXsatso bor de kho na bstan pa yin no zhes shes par bya'o/ 1so sor bshad na gsang ba'i don ni spar khab tu rang bzhin sogs sasum dang / bi ma las mi bstan pa'i gsang ba bsnan te bzhir phye na'ang 'dir rgyud nyid las / khong nas gab sbas don 'byin pa/ /zhes pa ltar sab sbas gnyis su 'du bar rje rong klong gnyis bzhed pa ltar bshad de/ sab pa'i sasang ba ni/ gnas lugs rang bzhin gyi rgyud dang / de la lto sa pa'i lam 'bras rnams zab cing gting dpas dka' bas shin —tu dbang rnon ma gtogs pa gzhan gyis rtogs mi nus pa'o/ /sba sa pa'i gsang ba ni/ bsang ba bla med kyi lta sgom spyod pa'i sand thun min rnams snod min la rnam pa thams cad du sba dbos pas der bzhag ste/ 'di sanyis rtogs dka' ba dang / rtobs su mi rung ba'i khyad par gyis dbye bar bshad do/ /snying po'i don ni/77

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3————ma ba —ma ba —ba ba ———ba —ba —ba —྾4 ྾—ba snying po'i skad dod sa ra/ hri da ya/ gar+bha sasum las/ dang po'i steng mas bshad na/ gcig las mang po 'phro ba'i sazhi la 'jug pas sems nyid rtobs pa dang ma rtos/sa pa las 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad 'phro zhing / de gtan la 'bebs pa'i rgyud 'di yang bstan pa thams cad kyi 'phro gzhir gyur pa'o/ /tri da ya 'a sa bshad na/ snying ltar gces spras su bya ba la 'jug ste/ theg pa'i sgo bang nas zhubs kyang mthar thug 'di las mi 'da' bas byang chub 'dod pa rnams kyis don du gnyer bya'i satso bor gyur pa ste snga ma la rgyu'i snying po dang / phyi ma la 'bras bu'i snying po zhes bshad do/ /gar+bha ni glegs bam kyi dbu na bzhugs pa gtso bo'i don te/ shun pa'i nang gi snying po lta bu bcud 'dus pa'i don la bya'o/ /de'ang song 'og sga thes pa thams cad zhal bsdur yang /'di'i lam la byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs mkhas kyi gnad 'dus shing rdzogs pa las lha ga pa'i lam gzhan med pas sazhi lam 'bras bu'i sand bcud du 'dril ba'o/ /de kho na nyid ni gsum ste/ ma bcos/ pa'i/ ma nor ba'i/ bzhan ma yin pa'iXde kho na nyid do/ / dang po ni/ gdod nas rang bzhin dag pa'i ye shes glo dur ba'i kun rtog dang de'i bag chabs kyi rnyogs pas basbad pa la sems can dang / de gtan log pa la sangs rgyas su btags thing /23

pong/ 3 rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum /—4——ba4—— ྾4 —nga —44—྾ —tsu44——————4—bsang lngabs kyi thabs mkhas kyis gnyug ma'i rang bzhin rjen la phyungs te bsgoms pa kho nas chab rom chur zhu ba ltar bslad pa de rang log tu 'gro bas 'od sasal snying po'i lam la rgyu'i de kho na nyid ces bya'o// /gnyis nga1 ni/ lam des rang gnas kyi ye thes dri bral du byas pa kho nas sku dang ye shes kyi 'khor lo thams cad sasal bar rang 'byung ba ste 'bras bu'i de kho na nyid ces bya/gsum pa ni/ de ltar na shes bya sazhi dang / bsgrub bya 'bras bu banyis ka banyug ma mi shigs pa'i sems gcig du las gud na med de/ nge la rgyu 'azas ro gcis pa'i de kho na nyid ces kyang bya'o/ 1nges pa'i don ni/ de ltar gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam bzhab mdzad pa de dag kyang gdul bya la drang ba'i don du bstan pa'i ldem dkangs lta bu ma yin te/ dbang rdon mchos gi gdul bya la rgyal ba nyid kyis ji ltar thugs su chud pa'i dgongs don mthar thug pa bstan pa'o/ /mtshan nang bsang ltar bshad pa phyogs mthong tsam ni/ nang ltar na snying sa'i mi shibs pa ni bdod nas rang la gnas kyang mtshon dka' bas bsang ba/ de nyid la gsang lngags kyi zab gnad thams cad 'dus pas snying po/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis ye shes kyi snang ba de nyid gsal bar sad pa de kho na nyid/ snying po'i thig le de sazhi lam 'bras bsum gyi srog tu 2—

gsang snyi nga spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3ba —4ba 4ba 4ba babartse —ba ba ba ྾ba 44—ba 4—ba nges pas na nges pa ste/ rgyud sde'i rdzobs rim rnams su rtsa 'khor gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i khyad par mi 'dra ba mang yang gsang ba sgyu 'phrul las snying ga'i 'khor lo btso bor byed pas de ltar sa/sungs te bshad tshul sacig go/ /yang 'khor lo bzhi dang sbyar na/ lte ba'i dbyings phyug lnga'i thig le ni gsang ba dang / snying ga'i ye shes snying po'i thig le ni snying po dang / mgrin pa'i rngam ma'i thig le ni de kho na nyid dang / spyi bo'i kun tu bzang po'i thig le la nges pa zhes bshad do/ /gsang ba ltar na/ rtsa sanas kyi jis le bde ba'i ye shes kyi ro dang bcas pa rang chas su yod kyang ma shes pas gsang ba/ thib le de 'a phung khams thams cad kyi bcud 'dus/ pas snying po/ thabs lam zab mos gnad du bsgrun pas lhan skyes kyi rang zhal ji bzhin mthong ba de kho na nyid/ thig le de nyid gzhi 'a ma 'bras bu gsum ka'i gnad sros tu nges pa la nges pa zhes bshad de bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag go/ /de ltar na rgyud 'di rgyud lung man ngag ba/sum kyi gnad bsdus yin pas rgyud dang mthun pa sobs mtshan bsum du byung zhing / rang gi ngo bo ma hā yo ga la ltos pa'i man ngag a ti yo ga'i rgyud du gnas pas glegs bam gyi klad du man ngag dang mthun pa'i mtshan 'ba' zhib smos zhes gsung ngo / /2 6

pob// 3 rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/4ba ba ba ba ྾ba ba 4—ba ྾4ba—— — 4——ba —ba————ba bganyis pa la sa/nyis te/ don gyi rnam grangs rnam par dbye ba dang / chig bi rnam grangs rnam par dbye ba'o/ /dang po la'ang / rgyud 'byung ba'i rgyu gleng bzhi/ rkyen gleng bslang / 'bras/ bu yongs su shes nga1ra bya ba rgyud don / rgyud kyi dbos 'brel1 'khor la sadams thi/nga bstan pa gtad pa ste lnga las/ dang po ni/ ba/nga du ston 'bo/ ra tshogs pa de'i tshe rgyud 'byung bas phun sum tshogs pa lnga lda naXni gleng gzhi'o/ /sgra bshad ni/ gleng zhi'i skad dod rā na zhes pa sbyin pa la 'jug ste/ khungs ldan kyi lo rgyus ma rnyed nga1sa yid mi ches pa rnams 'a nges pa sbyin pa'i phyir dang / rgyud don gleng ba'i gzhir gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /dbye na thun mong ma yin pa dang / thun mong sga gleng sazhi gnyis las/ dang po ni thabs lam/ dang sbyar ba ste/ de la'ang steng 'og gi sgo 'i lam dang sbyar ba gnyise las/ dang po ni/ gnas snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa bzhi dang / ston nga1 rtsa 'khor de'i dadus na sems mi shibs pa dwangs ma lnga'i jig le la brten te bzhugs pa dang / 'khor rtsa 'dab la rgyu ba'i las rlung gi bzhon pa can gyi rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang / bsta na pa'am chos bde bsal mi/ rtob pa'i ye shes bsam mi khyab kyi dgongs pa ste mi migs pa sad stobs kyis las/ rlung ye shes su sbyangs shing tshosas brgyad bde sto nga bi ros khyab nga1 2—3

gsang snying spyi don rin chen mdzod lde/ pod/ 3—ba——bab ba 4ba ba — ba —ba ma ba ba 4 ba ba ba 4 — — ——ni ston pas 'khor la chos bstan pa dang / dus ni dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du bsdam pa dus med kyi dasongs pa ma/ngon du gyur pa'i dus so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje btsun mo/'i pad+ma las ba'i'i dbyibs can ni sanas dang / thabs kyi rdo rje nor bu'i dbus na rtsa khams kyi bcud 'dus pa'i byang sems kyi thib le bzhusas nga1 ni sto na pa dang / byed bcing bi thabs dang bcas pa'i yab yu ma gnyis kyi gsang ba'i rnam shes ni 'khor dang / thabs lam gyi sems lnga rdzosas pa'i mtha'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni chos dang /ston pa de'i mthus 'khor de dag chos de'i ngo bor skyes pa ni sto na 'bor zhu 'chad byas pa'i don dang / dus lngar bzhin te/ de lhar phun sum tshogs pa lnga'o/ /'di dag rgyud kyi thog mar 'byung ba'i e waṃ mā yā zhes pa'i yi ge bzhi dang sbya ra nas bshad rgyud kyis ji ltar 'grel ba so sas dgongs rgyan las shes shing le'u gnyis ba 'i sasang dbang sto na ba dang / dbang phyi ma sanyis sto na/ pa'i rgyud tshig gi shubs kyis kyang rim bzhin steng sgo dang 'os sbo /'i gleng sa'i thon par bshad rung bar mngon te/ nang sasang gi phun tshobs lnga ldan 'di dag gleng ba/zhir 'gyur tshul gyis shes pa 'i phyir te/ gleng bal+lang gi skabs su lhan cis pa'i 'khor rnams la sto na pab/ 'bras dngang bskur nas de rnams nang gi mngon byang lngas 27

pob/ 3 rdo grub 'jisas med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bur11bab———ba44————4—྾———4——40————ba4babyang chub pa na go phye ba'i 'khor gyi ched du/ e ma'o ye nas gsang ba'i chos sogs ched brjod zhus lan mdzad nga1 las 'phros te rgyud yongs rdzobs byung ba yin la/ de lta bu'i mngon byang lnga po'ang snying ga dang sasang ba'i 'og min du 'tshang rgya tshul yin pa'i gnad kyis nge la ltos pa'i phun sum tshogs pa lnga gleng gzhir song ba yin 'es dam pa lnga ma dag ba'ed do/ /gnyis pa la longs sku'i gleng gzhi'am rgyud 'byung ba khyad par can kyi gleng sazhi dang / de'i zhar byung gdul bya dgos ched du bstan pa khro bo'i gleng gzhi/ sprul sku 'gro ba 'dul ba'i gleng bzhi'am bstan pa spyi'i gleng gzhi ste bsum las/ dang po ni/ bob sazhung las/ ston sanas 'khor dang sbud pa dang / ban+ta na nga dus kyis thes nga/ra bya/ /zhes phun sum tshosas pa drus tu bshad kyang / 'dir sdud po phun tshogs 'bor la bsdus nas lngar bya'o/ /de la gnas ni/ spyan 'grel 'a sa/ don gyi/ rig pa'i/ gsang ba'i/'jig rten gnas kyi// dbang phyug chen po'i 'og min dang lngar bshad pa'i ya gyal phyi ma ste 'dir bstan gyi dbang phyus chen po ni bla na med pari chos kyi rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug ste longs spyod rdzosas pa'i sku'o/ /de lta bu'i gnas de rang bzhin dang ngo bo sanyis kyi sgo nas bshad pa'i dang po la spyi'i rang bzhin ni/38

bsangasnying spyi don rinachen mdzod lde/ pon 3—ba ba —4 ba ba —ba — —ra —— —ba —ba ——ba ba —— ྾ba ba ba ba ba 'grel chung las/ mtha' dbus med pa'i chos kyi dbyings/ /de ni gnas kyi bla mar 'dod/ /ces pa ltar chos kyi dbyings yin la/cha ༅sa so so'i rang bzhin ni/ 'og gzhi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin ye thes lnga dang / gru chad kyi bden bzhi dang / bar khyams kyi bden pa dbyer med la sogs pa'o/ /gnas kyi ngo bo ni/ rnam pa'i khyad par te 'grel chung las/ sazhal yas gzhi dang rgyu dang rgya//dbyibs dang glo 'bur rtse mo dang / /rgyan dang sgo khyud rta babs dang / /mtshan nyid bdan gyi rnam pa ste/ /bcu gcig dag gis dbye bar bya/ /zhes bsungs pa ltar ro/ /ston pa phun tshogs bshad pa la'ang rang bzhin dang ngo bo gnyis te/ de'ang dkyil 'khor gyi brda don ngo sprod la dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid bstan pa zhes brjod pa ltar dag pa'i rten dang brten pa'i ye thes kyi de nyid la rang bzhin dang / gzusas kyi rnam pa la ngo bo zhes btags pa yin pas rang bzhin chos sku'i phyogs nas dang / ngo bo gzugs sku'i phyogs nas bstan dkos so/ /de la ston pa'i rang bzhin ni 'grel chung las/ /byang chub mchog gi ngo bo dang / /chos rnams rol par longs spyod dang / /phyosas dus bde gshegs bdag po dang / /chos so cob dang dbyer med pa'o/ /'es bzhir bshad cing / de'i dang po la'ang chos nyid de bzhin nyid sgrib 7 9

za da/ 3 rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'asnyem— 4—————ba——ba——bab——ba —4——————bab——byed kyi dri ma mtha' dag spangs pas mnyam par ma ba'as nga/ med pa'i tshul byis mngon du ma/dzad pa de bzhin nyid du nar so na nga/'i rang bzhin dang / de'i dbang bis 'bras bu'i chos rgya mtsho lta du rtsol med rang byung du brnyes pa yon tan ra/ btsal lha na gyis1 grub nga1'i rang bzhin ye shes reXre'ang kun tu bzang ngo 'i rang bajin yin nga1sa tshad 'di tsam zhes bzung du che1da pas ye shes mtha' bapūs dang bral ba'i rang bzhin/ spangs rtobs mthar phyin gyi bo 'phang la bzhugs kyang spid 'i'i mtha' sanyis gang dbang bsgyur 'a1nga sazung 'dzin dang bral ba'i chos nyid las mi sayo phyogs su'ang brjod du med pa'am/ yang na mnyam bzhas bi dbongs nga1 mtshan ma'i yul can sa/nga gis kyang mtshon du med pa 'bras bu la mnga' mdzad kyang ngo bo bstan du med pa'i rang ba'in no/ /banyis pa ni/ ye thes sgyu ma'i spyod yu' tshad med pa la dbang bsgyur yang gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'iXchos nyid las mi poyo ba ste/'di la mnyam pa nyid mngon du mdzad kyang spyod yu'1 dang zal ba'i rang bzhin zhes kyang bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ phyos/sa bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba thams cad bsdu na risas lngar 'du zhing lnga po'ang risas drub pa la 'du bas rigs thams cad kyi bdab por bzhugs pa ste/gcib dang du ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin zhes kyang bya'o/ /ba'i/ 3()

por1 3 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba— — 4 0ba ba ba— ba ———ba— —— ——ba —ba — ——4————rtasas su phyas drub dang / des 'gro don mdzad pa'i rtags su rdo rje 'a sobs pa'i mtshan ma drus 'dzin pa'o/ /bzhi ba ni/ sku stong pa nyid/ gsung mtshan ma med pa dang / thusas smo na pa med pa ste gsum po dbyer med pa'i rtasas su mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal sasum mnga' ba'o/ /'khor phun tshogs la lhan ceg pa dang go bye ba'i 'khor gnyis/dang po la rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i/ rig pa khyad par can gyi/ dad pas btam nyan pa'i 'bor ro/ /dang po ni/ de bzhin sashesas pa rnam par shes pa'i rgyal po sobs rgyal ba risas lnga ste1rnam par shes pa'i rgyal po zhes nga1 'di la kun mkhyen chen pos rnam par snang mdzad yin pa'i sgrub byed mang du 'bod par mdzad la/ zur pa ni glang chen rab 'bog bi rgyud dang / nyi 'od seng ge'i 'grel ba dang / rdo rje las rim sogs kyi khungs la brten nas mi bskyod par bzhed de/ gter bdab gling pa sku mched sobs kyang phyi ma'i rjes su 'brang ngo / /rigs lnga 'di das thal ba las/ 'khor lo'i lte bar mi 'jibs steng / /bdag po kun bzang 'khor rnams la/ /kun 'byung sgyu 'phrul ston pa'i tshe/ mi bskyo da rgyal po mdun na gnas/ /zhes pa ltar ribs drug pa rgyud kyi ston par bzhengs pa la ltos te 'khor dang / spyir 'chad nga 'i rte—3
